title: MitiruNovel Script
description: JSON schema for mitiru.novel script objects (F-04). Consumed by mitiru_novel.js.

id.description: Unique identifier for this script. Used as save-state key.

lines.description: Ordered array of scene lines executed sequentially.

TextLine.description: Dialogue or narration. Typewriter animation plays; voice is optional.

label.description: Optional jump target label (used by choice.next).

speaker.description: Character name shown above the text box. Empty = narration.

text.description: Line content. Displayed with typewriter animation.

voice.description: URL of voice audio file. Played via new Audio(url).play().

BgLine.description: Change background image with CSS opacity crossfade (~400ms).

path.description: URL or relative path to the background image.

SpriteLine.description: Show or hide a character sprite.

id.description: Sprite identifier. Used to update/hide by name.

path.description: Image URL. Required when hide is false/absent.

pos.description: Horizontal position. CSS percentage or keyword.

hide.description: When true, remove the sprite instead of showing it.

ChoiceLine.description: Present player choices. Execution pauses until a choice is picked. Terminal — lines after a choice in the same array are unreachable if next labels are used.

label.description: Button text shown to the player.

next.description: Target line label to jump to on pick. If empty or absent and no matching label exists, the script ends.

WaitLine.description: Pause execution for a fixed number of milliseconds.
